data.body: Task 116 done: bounded loops execute. A `loop` header declares exitCondition + maximumIterations 1..=64 and routes body/exit/fallback; one declared `feedback` edge closes a single-entry/single-exit region (nesting <= 4, no wait/completion inside); only declared feedback edges close a cycle. analyze_loop_regions is shared by validator and compiler; routes may come from configuration.route, the top-level route, or the typed source handle. The executor repeats the region per iteration, decides completion by the frozen condition, and routes the declared fallback with a limit-exceeded observation when the bound or deadline is exhausted; loop frames persist across suspensions so a resume keeps its iteration without replay. Activities carry the frame; spans are iteration-stamped. The editor offers the loop with its exit-condition panel, bound and typed routes, and a declared loop is no longer a cycle. v1 gaps: no cumulative cost ledger, no iteration badge, no inherited tool exchanges.
